specification_metadata.title: Apple AGX G18 Command Stream Wire Protocol & Descriptor Specification

flags.description: Execution flags: Coherent (bit 0), Sync (bit 1), Profiling (bit 2), Secure (bit 3), LateEval (bit 4)

context_id.description: Hardware Context Identifier mapped in RTBuddy scheduler

field_layout.description: 64-bit unique telemetry and profiling trace identifier (Metal system trace)
64-bit GPU virtual address pointing to contiguous payload command stream buffer
Payload valid byte count and total allocated buffer bounds

used_bytes.description: Actual valid payload byte count written by userland encoder

allocated_bytes.description: Total allocated buffer capacity (16 KB page multiple)

field_layout.description: 64-bit pointer / token for IOGPUIOFenceListHead and AGXBlockFence synchronizations
Completion tracking timestamp token and status page ring slot index

queue_index.description: Status page completed_stamps array slot index (0..1023)

stamp_value.description: Monotonically increasing completion value asserted upon execution finish

field_layout.description: GPU virtual address of Parameter Scene Allocation (MList / MTileArray / VHeap / Surface Bindings)
64-bit Metal shared event completion descriptor and signaling mask

0x01.name: CMD_3D_RENDER_PASS
0x01.description: Submits full Tile-Based Deferred Rendering pass (Vertex/Tiling phase followed by Fragment phase)
0x01.hardware_pipeline: TA -> USC Vertex -> Tile Allocator -> USC Fragment -> Tile Buffer Store

0x02.name: CMD_COMPUTE_DISPATCH
0x02.description: Launches general-purpose compute kernel threadgroups into unified shader core clusters
0x02.hardware_pipeline: CDM -> USC Threadgroup Scheduler -> Shared Memory / Register File -> L2

0x03.name: CMD_BLIT_2D
0x03.description: Hardware 2D memory copy, DMA surface transfer, buffer clear, and texture sub-resource remapping
0x03.hardware_pipeline: Blit Engine DMA -> Memory Subsystem / Crossbar -> DRAM / SLC

0x04.name: CMD_RAY_TRACING_DISPATCH
0x04.description: Executes ray-generation, intersection, and closest-hit shaders with hardware Ray Intersection Accelerator
0x04.hardware_pipeline: CDM -> RIA Ray Stack -> BVH2/BVH4 Box/Triangle Intersection -> USC Shader

0x05.name: CMD_TILE_LOAD_STORE
0x05.description: Explicit on-chip tile memory load/store operations to/from system DRAM

0x06.name: CMD_BLIT_COPY
0x06.description: Extended format conversion, MSAA resolve blit, and compressed ASTC tile unpacking

0x07.name: CMD_BARRIER_FENCE
0x07.description: Inserts pipeline execution barrier and flushes USC L1 instruction/data caches

0x08.name: CMD_SHARED_EVENT_SIGNAL
0x08.description: Signals a Metal SharedEvent object upon hardware completion of preceding commands

0x09.name: CMD_SHARED_EVENT_WAIT
0x09.description: Suspends pipeline execution until specified SharedEvent reaches threshold value

0x0A.name: CMD_RAY_TRACING_BVH_BUILD
0x0A.description: Constructs or refits acceleration structures (BVH2 / BVH4) using hardware traversal accelerators

0x0F.name: CMD_NOP
0x0F.description: No-operation descriptor used for ring alignment, latency pads, and heartbeat keepalive

data_masters.name: VDM
data_masters.description: Vertex / Meshlet Data Master (Geometry Phase & Tiling Control)

data_masters.name: PDM
data_masters.description: Pixel / Primitive Data Master (Rasterization & Fragment Phase)

data_masters.name: CDM
data_masters.description: Compute Data Master (GPGPU, Threadgroups & RIA Ray Tracing)

queue_id.description: Hardware Queue ID allocated by XNU driver during queue creation

tail_offset.description: 64-byte aligned ring byte offset pointing to latest producer write pointer (supports atomic batched submission)

flags.description: Doorbell flags: bit 63 indicates High-Priority/RealTime preemptive kick

indirect_command_buffers.dispatch_support: Concurrent 3D and Compute execution encoding on GPU timeline without CPU intervention

mesh_shaders.amplification: Hardware meshlet primitive culling and dynamic primitive expansion

ray_tracing.metal_api_parity: Full MTLAccelerationStructure, MTLLinkedFunctions, and Ray Tracing Pipelines

fast_resource_loading.hardware_path: ANS2 NVMe Storage Direct-to-GPU Memory DMA Streaming
